purpose: Freeze exact real-market research inputs so an experiment can be rerun against the same population, period, normalized candles, and chronological plan.

dataContract.finalPolicy: Only normalized candles with final=true may enter research calculations.

hashPolicy.perSymbolHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON array of candleFieldsForHash in candleOrdering
hashPolicy.populationHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON of populationDefinition plus symbolsSorted
hashPolicy.datasetHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON containing snapshot identity fields and ordered perSymbol hashes
hashPolicy.chronologicalPlanHash: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON of the resolved chronological plan
